answer: Reputation decays exponentially with a fixed half-life, so past influence fades unless an identity provides sustained, honest service. EigenTrust centrality propagates through trust edges, weighted by reciprocal, transitive support; a freshly spawned sybil has almost no trusted incoming paths and thus near-zero eigenvector centrality, leaving it unable to pass consensus. A river of colluding accounts cannot cultivate a garden of trust or forge corroborated history overnight.
